contract_title: Apex Industrial Holdings - Senior Credit Agreement

variables.name: is_acquisition
variables.description: Whether borrower is within a Material Permitted Acquisition Period

clauses.title: Consolidated Leverage Ratio (Standard)
clauses.original_text: The Borrower shall not permit the Consolidated Leverage Ratio as of the end of any Fiscal Quarter of the Borrower to exceed 3.50 to 1.00...

clauses.title: Consolidated Leverage Ratio Step-Up
clauses.original_text: ...provided, however, that upon the consummation of any Material Permitted Acquisition, such ratio threshold shall automatically step up to 4.00 to 1.00...

clauses.title: Maximum Debt Ceiling with EBITDA Threshold
clauses.original_text: In no event shall Consolidated Total Indebtedness exceed $30,000,000 whenever Consolidated EBITDA is less than $8,000,000.

clauses.title: Minimum Interest Coverage Ratio
clauses.original_text: The Borrower shall maintain an Interest Coverage Ratio of not less than 2.50 to 1.00 at all times.

invariants.name: Acquisition Step-Up Compatibility with Hard Debt Ceiling
invariants.description: The 4.0x leverage step-up capacity must never exceed the Section 6.02 $30M debt cap when EBITDA is under $8M.
invariants.formal_condition: (is_acquisition == True and ebitda < 8000000 and ebitda > 0) => (4.0 * ebitda <= 30000000)

invariants.name: Non-negative Solvency Invariant
invariants.description: EBITDA and Debt remain non-negative in all valid states.
